description: Puts a tag on Riddles - ONE assignment per Riddle, never the tag itself (riddle_tag_list reads the labels of a project, riddle_tag_remove takes a tag off again, riddle_tag_delete removes a label). Gives one Riddle (UUID) or many (UUIDs, max 100) the tag named by tagName - created in each Riddle's OWN project if it has none of that name, so one call can span projects - or by tagId, which exists in one project and therefore works only for that project's Riddles. Re-tagging changes nothing and no tag needs a publish. There is no projectId here: a tag lives in the project of the Riddle it is put on, which is where the scope comes from. Returns the tag plus all tags of the Riddle, and with UUIDs the {bulk, operation, summary, results} envelope with one entry per Riddle, a failure (no edit permission, a tagId from another project) reported as that entry's "error" without stopping the others. Only if the Riddle's origin.writableByThisKey is true (riddle_get, riddle_list): riddle://reference/concepts/access.

UUID.description: The UUID of the single Riddle to tag. Pass either this or UUIDs.

UUIDs.description: Several Riddles to tag at once, as Riddle UUID strings, e.g. ["6FA740EW", "OllsevHa"] (max 100). Pass either this or UUID.

tagId.description: The ID of an existing tag, as returned by riddle_tag_list. Pass either this or tagName.

tagName.description: The name of the tag. Each Riddle's project gets the tag of that name, created if it has none yet. Pass either this or tagId.

name: riddle_tag_add
